definitions.gloss: shuttle bus; courtesy bus; pick-up and drop-off bus
definitions.explanation: A free bus run by a hotel, hot-spring inn, hospital, school, or wedding venue to carry guests between its premises and a nearby station or airport. {送迎|そうげい} means seeing off and meeting, so the service covers both directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{送迎|そうげい}バス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ています→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: There is a shuttle bus from the station.

examples.japanese: {送迎|そうげい}バス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ご⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: The shuttle bus is available free of charge.

examples.japanese: {送迎|そうげい}バス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you would like the shuttle bus, please contact us by the day before.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{遠|とお}くて→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{送迎|そうげい}バス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}ける→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Even if the inn is far from the station, you can get there without a car as long as there's a shuttle bus.

notes:
{送|そう} (to send off) + {迎|げい} (to meet) + ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧. Almost always a free service laid on by the destination, which distinguishes it from a paid route bus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送迎|そうげい}バス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a shuttle bus runs
- {送迎|そうげい}バス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to use the shuttle bus
- ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧{送迎|そうげい}バス: free shuttle bus
- {送迎|そうげい}バス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時刻表|じこくひょう}→時刻表：01031_jikokuhyou⟧: the shuttle bus timetable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送迎|そうげい}→送迎：07050_sougei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pick up and drop off — the verb, also used of people driving guests personally
- ⟦{路線|ろせん}バス→路線バス：20398_rosenbasu⟧: route bus — the ordinary paid public bus
- シャトルバス: shuttle bus — the loanword, used more for airports and event sites
